frontend.snapshotNote: Full regular run after browser/Ozon fixes, before the final purchase first-paint changes. The latter have a separate 6-file/29-test regression and a newer build; final all-suite rerun is not claimed.

localApi.snapshotNote: Historical full isolated run before the final multi-shop page materialization changes. Those later source changes have a separate 9-file/51-test regression and real SQLite comparison; a final full-suite pass is not claimed.

desktop.concurrentRunNote: The earlier same-source cross-package concurrent run had 910 passes and 3 failures, including two 100ms synthetic CEF startup timeouts. Their isolated 22-test recheck and same-source full standalone run passed; no timeout/threshold was changed. Timing stability remains unverified under concurrent full-suite load.

repairSnapshot.note: Package-wide regression results do not mark every module's eight acceptance dimensions passed. Frontend is the configured regular runner, not the separately requested V2 stress suite. Native/packaged/live remote deletion acceptance remains unverified. See the deletion handoff for version-bound evidence and unresolved gates.

releaseBlockers.message: Penalty pagination is fixed and the current development frontend is updated with 214 isolated tests passing, including real scheduler/HTTP/SQLite integration. Currency changes were withdrawn to draft and original currency behavior restored. Profit core freeze has 3 hash differences: 2 pre-existing runtime differences and the new rating read/cache support change in profitLedgerMapping.jsx. No freeze hash or calculation version was refreshed; formal freeze review and live Ozon pagination acceptance remain open.

First-batch delivery is activated. Multi-shop backend pagination now selects compact merge keys before hydrating only returned full orders, with 51 targeted tests and identical 30000-order SQLite comparison payloads. User forbids native mouse/keyboard or foreground takeover; owned visible test processes were stopped and tests are background-only. Neither the earlier empty/unauthorized fixture UI nor the new database timing is a real user-experience pass. Frontend full materialization, actual same-scope UI latency and background contention remain open.

Earlier limited platform reads remain historical evidence. Expanded isolated account/HTTP experiments exposed and repaired three previously untested classes: failed responses becoming empty success, overlapping pages falsely completing, and unknown charges becoming zero. The new compiled-runtime transport fixture passes 21 tests; 42 installed CEF checks and 373 related regressions also pass. The transport uses synthetic per-owner cookie callbacks and fake HTTP, not real third-party authentication. Runtime and frontend are updated. All original plugin functions, real platform variants, transaction/write workflows, packaging and long-run acceptance remain open. No real payments, orders, deletions or messages were issued.

Cache maintenance now waits 60 quiet seconds after last-session close, cancels queued checks on reopen, and uses bounded failure/cancellation backoff; successful verified worker exits retain the 6-hour rate limit. Active owners, native-exit fences, cookies, business data and backups remain protected. Two large synthetic capacity profiles were disposed after verification; future capacity CLI supports identity-bound disposal. This is not a whole-disk hard limit or real long-running browser acceptance; unknown/retained artifacts and real backups remain preserved.

The same-source cross-package concurrent full test run produced two 100ms synthetic CEF startup timeouts. Isolated lifecycle and full standalone desktop rechecks pass those cases, but concurrent test timing reliability is not proven; original failures are preserved and no timeout or performance threshold was raised.
The five-test rollback-journal prototype is not integrated with application-wide admission, reader shutdown, restore transaction ownership and restart recovery. Unsafe online imports remain blocked.

Hidden source-app purchase reads now verify 10 shops, 100000 products and 200000 orders with normal isolated-issuer login and 15 read-only UI interactions. Full load takes 76.43s, all-shop selection 4.91s and one shop switch 10.19s; performance is NOT accepted despite default-shop scrolling passing 105 FPS. The diagnostic observation window does not waive the original 16s deadline. True pagination/incremental read models, all-page workflows and packaged/live acceptance remain incomplete.

Financial formulas and currency handling remain unchanged. September 7 structure audit: 20 size violations, 0 dependency cycles. Freeze differences: profit core 6, insight 0, market 5, image 27, follow-seller 9. Runtime changes have targeted and Chromium equivalence evidence but require formal freeze reconciliation. No thresholds or protected hashes were refreshed. Differences are not equivalent to that many independently confirmed business bugs.

Frontend production and desktop dependency audits are clear; frontend all-dependency audit still reports esbuild low and UUID/ExcelJS moderate findings requiring treatment or documented approval. No blanket waiver was applied.

Active OpenClaw 2026.7.1-2 still has 11 dependency findings (7 high, 4 moderate). Candidate 2026.9.1 has audit=0, Weixin import and isolated gateway checks, but complete equivalence of reserveTokensFloor=24576 and memory flush behavior is unproven. SDK exists at the hoisted root; hard-coded nested paths need proper resolution. Root overrides on the shrinkwrapped old engine were proven ineffective even after successful installation through an existing local proxy. Active dependencies were not replaced. The MCP timeout unit bug was independently fixed and tested.

Source-mode isolated-issuer login is verified for two hidden pages. Isolated installer, upgrade, complete profile restore, long-running load, production-issuer authorization and real-platform readback acceptance are not complete.

Deletion source repairs and isolated fixtures do not prove real remote cleanup. The user-authorized source-mode frontend/native runtime files are now activated and readback-verified; the app was not launched by the agent. Five real pending operations were not resumed. Profile/database/installer were not modified; real remote deletion acceptance remains unverified.

Native CEF passes isolated cookie/maintenance, proxy, frame capture, version and scope guards; the installed September 6 runtime is readback-verified and old artifacts preserved. Existing credentials were used only for readonly checks and private isolated cookie snapshots. This proves limited real Ozon/1688 reads, not all account functions. Captcha, full PDD/Taobao order flows, cross-origin capture, OS sleep, installer and long-running load remain unverified. No user mouse/keyboard or foreground takeover was used.
V2 remains a separate, unaccepted deployment path. Current target uses the existing local-first configuration; V2 must not inherit this target's results.
